A single **route animation engine** (HTML + GSAP, rendered by HyperFrames) reads three data files and draws
everything from **one single clock**—car position, camera, traveled line, pins, HUD, altitude track, and data cards
all come from the same time function, so nothing falls out of sync.
f15326715fd2: - **98–99.5% of the input came from cache** — that’s what keeps the cost low despite ~85 M tokens read.
f62f1abe2bd4: It joins the OSRM legs and the ferry line (OSM) into a single route, with ⟪P0⟫a single cumulative kilometer⟪P1⟫. It marks where the ferry starts/ends and where the border is (OSM polygon ⟪P2⟫), fits each stop at the right kilometer, and looks up altitude every 5 km from OpenTopoData (SRTM 30 m). It resamples the route every 0.15 km in Web Mercator coordinates z14.
f90460e166eb: A route engine, not a video editor
fc2f60f1eb3e: Measures BPM and phase of the beat and the bar (spectral flow + autocorrelation). This tells you what second the car sets off and when the border stamp drops.
